confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Tuscan tourist pricing, not checked against live menus, listings, or booking pages. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately reliable. Cocktail and wine anchors are weaker and use the local beer-to-drink relationship. Accommodation is least certain: July is peak season in Tuscany, Pisa absorbs Florence overflow demand, and the tax and fee inclusion is estimated. The FX rate comes from a search-result snippet of the RBA exchange-rates overview page, dated 15 October 2026; I did not open the F11.1 table itself.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on smaller Tuscan tourist cities near Florence, such as Lucca, adjusted for Pisa's proximity to Florence and July peak-season accommodation demand.
